name: Ternate (Bastiong) - Tidore (Rum)
notes: Short sheltered strait crossing. Distance is great-circle between approximate port coordinates times a 1.15 routing factor. Demand is an order-of-magnitude estimate for the ferry share of traffic.

name: Ternate - Sofifi
notes: Link to the provincial capital, today served mostly by speedboats. Distance and demand are estimates.

name: Ternate - Jailolo
notes: West Halmahera link. Distance and demand are estimates.

name: Tobelo - Daruba (Morotai)
notes: Halmahera Utara to Morotai, exposed to Pacific swell. Distance and demand are estimates.

name: Ternate - Batang Dua (Mayau)
notes: Long open-sea route across the Molucca Sea, included to test range limits. Distance and demand are estimates.
